name: laravel-crm
title: Halka CRM - contacts & deals pipeline
description: Laravel 13 CRM with a contacts directory and a deals pipeline (lead/qualified/won/lost), Blade views styled with Tailwind from a CDN, SQLite storage and a hand-written session login with an admin-only user area.
start: php artisan migrate --force --seed && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8007 --no-reload

env.name: APP_KEY
env.description: Laravel encryption key (base64:...). If empty the Docker entrypoint generates a temporary one, so sessions reset on every restart; set it for stable sessions (`php artisan key:generate --show`).

env.name: APP_URL
env.description: Public base URL used for generated links.

env.name: DB_CONNECTION
env.description: Database driver; the demo only ships SQLite.

env.name: DB_DATABASE
env.description: Path of the SQLite file; created by the entrypoint if missing.

env.name: PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS
env.description: Worker processes for the PHP built-in server behind `artisan serve`.

auth.description: Laravel session guard driven by a hand-written LoginController (Auth::attempt), `auth` middleware for the app, and a custom EnsureUserIsAdmin middleware (alias `admin`) protecting /admin/*. CSRF via the framework's _token field.

persistence: sqlite file (image default /data/database.sqlite on the /data volume; local default database/database.sqlite). Entrypoint runs migrate --force --seed on every start; the seeder is idempotent (skips when a user exists) and creates 2 users, 20 contacts, 15 deals.
notes: Runs `php artisan serve` inside php:8.3-cli as root (fine for a demo; put a reverse proxy in front for TLS). No Node/Vite build step - Tailwind comes from a CDN. Mount a volume at /data to persist the database. Provide APP_KEY to keep sessions valid across restarts. First start takes ~5-10 s (migrate + optimize).
